title: A Snake cannot be Pacified by Mercy
body:
Jesus Christ* will not come like he came the last time. He will come to kill the dragon because the world is
now full of evil. The first time he came he showed his mercy, with the result that people came against him,
wanting to kill him. This time his mission is to correct everything. You may pacify a cat by stroking him, but
not a snake!
- 01.01.1997
